# tir-list

> A catalog of modern web tools. Find Skills, Models, Containers, Servers, Agents and Tools.

## agents

- [Claude Code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code): Anthropic's agentic coding tool that lives in the terminal.

## containers

- [Wolfi](https://wolfi.dev/): Chainguard minimal Linux for containers.

## models

- [Muse Spark](https://www.meta.com/): Coding agent model family.

## servers

- [n8n MCP](https://n8n.io/): Workflow automation via MCP.
- [Zapier MCP](https://zapier.com/): 9,000+ apps via Zapier tools.

## skills

- [agents.md](https://agents.md/): Convention for AGENTS.md agent instructions.
- [Superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers): Agent skills for brainstorming, systematic debugging, and plan execution.

## tools

- [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/): GitHub on the command line: PRs, issues, and repos.
